persons.name: Jayajitāmitramalla
persons.evidence: śrīśrīsumati jayajitāmitramallana thva sā(5)phuli coyakāva saṃpūrṇṇāṃ yāṅā dina juro

date.as_written: saṃmvat 801 phālguṇa śudinavamī || ... śāke samvat 1602 vikramāsamvat 1737 karigastāda saṃmvat 4781

notes: The date is provided in four eras: NS 801, Śaka 1602, Vikrama 1737, and Kaliyuga ('karigastāda' for kaligatābda) 4781. Jayajitāmitramalla is the well-known Malla king of Bhaktapur.
